name: Mind Flayer
sourceDistinctions: Underdark lists 8 racial Hit Dice, LA +7, favored class Wizard, and ECL 15. The core character entry supplies the detailed racial traits.
Spell resistance is 25 + class levels. The listed innate Psionics use caster level 8. Mind Blast is a separate 4th-level-equivalent spell-like ability with a Charisma-based Will save.
The February 2006 Monster Manual errata specify Telepathy (Su) at 100 ft. with creatures that have a language.
The 3.5 FAQ discusses CR 8 for a base Mind Flayer and CR 9 for one with Wizard 1. It also clarifies that a warforged is vulnerable to Extract.
The Expanded Psionics Handbook presents a distinct 9th-level telepath stat block. This profile uses the core at-will spell-like suite.
portraitForm: Ilyth Voss, an original Mind Flayer archive warden
